subject: english-literature
title: Big Ideas, Small Places
welcome_lead: From a tiny garden, a whole theme can bloom.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on themes emerging through setting.
final_note: You can now link a setting to the theme it serves.

concepts.def: When place acts on the plot.
Wide world or era around events.

walkthroughs.body_html: Love, loss, courage and justice are universal themes — readers across cultures recognise them.
In some stories, a forest or sea behaves like a character — opposing or helping the hero. That's setting as character.
The macro setting might be 'wartime London'. The microsetting could be 'a damp Anderson shelter'. Both shape theme.

numericals.q: How many zoom-levels do we name here (micro + macro)?

free_texts.q: An idea recognised across cultures is a ____ theme.
